# Write General Project Content

Write and revise general project prose without imposing a document template.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Use for reports, research findings, project summaries, progress updates and other substantive writing when a narrower specialist does not fit. Also choose workflows on explicit request.

Example request:

> Write up these investigation findings for the team. Keep observations, conclusions and next steps distinct.

Expected result: A source-faithful, readable report organised for its reader, without unnecessary template sections.

## A concrete example

This illustrative example starts from the source facts below.

**Source facts and constraints:** Three approaches were examined. Two meet current requirements. The third requires a capacity test. No final approach has been chosen.

**Before**

> Investigation completed, several approaches evaluated and a final determination is forthcoming.

**After**

> We examined three approaches. Two meet the current requirements; the third needs a capacity test. We can choose between the first two now.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.8.0 --skill write-project-content
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/write-project-content/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/write-project-content/references/routing.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.

## Practices behind this skill

This skill uses Geekist's shared writing conventions for reports, summaries and other general prose when no specialist is a better match. It also supports explicit workflow selection without imposing a universal process.
